pages.title: Mixed Urinary Incontinence
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Full article and bibliography read. Verified MUI phenotyping and conservative approach against IUGA2024; verified urgency-treatment sequencing against AUA/SUFU2024; corrected ESTEEM primary-outcome clinical-importance interpretation.
pages.notes: ESTEEM small statistical difference did not meet its35-point clinical-importance threshold. Revised historical mandatory sequencing. Epidemiologic percentages and every smaller supporting study have not been independently reverified.

pages.title: Nocturia
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Full article and bibliography read. Checked sleep-period definition and diary indices against ICS. Checked NOCDURNA contraindications, sodium monitoring and fluid restriction against US label.
pages.notes: Replaced cautions with explicit label contraindications, added one-month sodium check and1h-before/8h-after fluid restriction; corrected mandatory return-to-sleep definition and removed unrelated drug-paper citation from CPAP. Other observational prevalence/CPAP effect claims have not all been revalidated.

pages.title: Stress Urinary Incontinence (Female)
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: ACP recommendation attribution; TOMUS objective versus subjective outcomes and equivalence; removed unreferenced procedure ranking.
pages.notes: Full text read. Corrected ACP subtype recommendations and replaced inconsistent success table with the specific TOMUS endpoints. Most epidemiology, ISD diagnostic cutoffs and all device-label claims remain outside independently verified scope.

pages.title: Stress Urinary Incontinence (Male)
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: AUA 2024 timing of surgery, assessment and AUS selection after radiation.
pages.notes: Full text read. Six-month consideration when not improving and one-year offer are already current. Pad bands are qualified. Individual series percentages and the prior MASTER source audit were not independently repeated.

pages.title: Urgency Incontinence & OAB
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Full article and bibliography read. Verified core diagnosis, selective testing and shared-decision treatment sequencing against AUA/SUFU2024.
pages.notes: Current page already separates symptoms from DO and allows minimally invasive treatment without mandatory drug/behavior trials. No further verified core-guideline correction in this pass. FUTURE and2026radiofrequency source audits remain those of the previous scoped update; not independently repeated here.

pages.title: Bladder Neck Contracture
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: BNC versus VUAS; first endoscopic options; MMC clinical-trial restriction and severe tissue complications.
pages.notes: Full text read. Added missing EAU MMC restriction; retrospective patency is not comparative efficacy. Series-specific rates and novel endoscopic reconstruction outcomes not independently reverified.

pages.title: Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: AUA 2026 tadalafil/alpha-blocker combination, uroselectivity, persistent retention versus an automatic surgery trigger.
pages.notes: Full text read. Replaced obsolete combination prohibition; clarified alfuzosin and persistent-retention assessment. Existing AUA/EAU 2026 references were already present. Aquablation 30–80 mL remains the EAU recommendation; larger-gland studies are not a universal equivalence claim. Not every procedural efficacy estimate or trial was independently rechecked.

pages.title: Dysfunctional Voiding
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Non-neurogenic distinction, urotherapy/biofeedback and limits of pediatric alpha-blocker evidence.
pages.notes: Full text read. Added controlled-evidence and off-label caveats; pediatric randomized evidence does not establish alpha-blocker efficacy. Many observational adult/pediatric response rates remain unverified individually.

pages.title: Female Urethral & Periurethral Masses
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: MRI limitations, suspicious mass tissue diagnosis and primary urethral-cancer staging.
pages.notes: Full text read. Replaced inaccessible generic NCCN attribution with verified EAU biopsy/cytology, CT staging and pelvic MRI guidance; qualified mandatory MRI wording. Numerical outcomes in the many institutional mass series were not individually rechecked; this is not an oncology treatment audit.

pages.title: Female Urethral Stricture
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Diagnostic specificity; AUA/EAU dilation versus urethroplasty options; female DCB off-label boundary; no universal dorsal superiority; review citation identity.
pages.notes: Full text read. Removed fictitious female bulbar-equivalent DCB step and routine DVIU equivalence, false pathognomonic imaging claim, rigid operative schedules and unsupported cross-study rankings. Corrected West/Lawrence title/DOI and attributed the 2025 22-study review to Turchi. Detailed technique instructions now point to the surgical hub. Remaining etiologic proportions and every small study were not independently verified.

pages.title: Primary Bladder Neck Obstruction
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Exact Nitti 2002 title/authors/DOI and core PBNO versus DV pathway.
pages.notes: Full text read during the citation-repair subtask in this session. Exact DOI repaired to 10.1016/S0022-5347(05)64846-X. Current EAU supports alpha-blockers first and BNI or intermittent catheterization after failure. The detailed incidence, diagnostic cutoffs and procedural outcomes were not independently validated.

pages.title: Underactive Bladder
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: UAB symptom syndrome versus urodynamic DU; no routine parasympathomimetics; anatomical versus functional outlet intervention.
pages.notes: Full text read. Added recommendation against routine parasympathomimetics and removed poor sphincter relaxation from the anatomical surgery indication list. Observational contractility predictors and all catheter outcome claims remain outside independent source verification.

pages.title: Urethral Diverticulum
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: UD imaging, observation versus symptomatic excision, pathology/continence counseling.
pages.notes: Full text read. Current EAU supports the main MRI and symptomatic-excision pathway and counseled non-synthetic concomitant sling choice. No new core correction established. All molecular pathology claims, small-series success rates and suggested 6–12 month staging interval were not independently validated.

pages.title: Urethral Prolapse
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Clinical ring-versus-caruncle diagnosis; mild conservative care; selected reduction/excision for symptomatic prolapse.
pages.notes: Full text read. Main pathway agrees with available pediatric series; evidence is not randomized and adults cannot be assumed equivalent. No new correction established. Individual operative details and all case-report claims not independently validated.

pages.title: Male Urethral Stricture
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Main endoscopic/reconstructive selection; LSE stage descriptions versus mandatory operations; Scandinavian RCT sexual endpoints.
pages.notes: Full text read. Removed rigid operation column from staging and corrected penile complications versus IIEF-5. A collagen subtype statement conflicts across secondary sources and needs exact primary-text reconciliation; no speculative reversal made. Epidemiology, biomarker findings and all small-series claims remain unverified.

pages.title: Vesicourethral Anastomotic Stenosis
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Nonobliterative endoscopic management, reconstruction and MMC restriction.
pages.notes: Full text read. Aligned MMC safety with BNC. Individual robotic-series claims, precise continence risks and every outcome denominator remain unverified.

pages.title: Anterior Compartment Prolapse
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: April 2026 Cochrane anterior repair update; functional obstruction cannot be inferred from prolapse alone.
pages.notes: Full text read. Replaced 2016 review with 2026 update and separated recurrence efficacy from mesh harms/regulatory availability. Corrected blanket assertion that cystocele explains obstructed voiding. Specific anatomic predictors and categorical apical-repair wording require clinician judgment; not all surgical-series estimates independently rechecked.

pages.title: Apical Prolapse
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: 2023 Cochrane vault-prolapse comparison; bounded colpocleisis and future-pregnancy counseling.
pages.notes: Full text read. Updated 2016 Cochrane citation to 2023 and removed universal lowest-morbidity colpocleisis claim. Added future-childbearing boundary for Manchester. OPTIMAL/SAVE U and every mesh-exposure percentage were not independently reverified in this pass.

pages.title: "Obstetric Perineal Lacerations"
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: 2026 IUGA OASI repair technique and perioperative aftercare.
pages.notes: Verified partial EAS end-to-end and separate IAS repair; added antibiotic, bowel/bladder care and figure-of-eight avoidance. Broader birth epidemiology, biomechanics and individual repair studies remain incompletely verified.

pages.title: POP Overview
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Pessary estrogen RCT, shared procedure selection, long-term mesh exposure, POP-Q preference.
pages.notes: Removed mandatory pessary, unsupported fixed SCP age/BMI mandates, universal colpocleisis superiority and misdescribed Baden-Walker grade. Added 2025 estrogen trial and qualified long-term mesh exposure. Preexisting 2026 trials were retained; not all historical risk ratios, fitting-success tables or genetic claims were independently verified.

pages.title: Posterior Compartment Prolapse
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Symptom-driven treatment, non-routine mesh and coordination with defecatory physiology.
pages.notes: Full text read. Main approach avoids treating incidental rectocele alone and separates functional from structural symptoms. Quantitative size thresholds, comparative VMR claims and every anorectal source need deeper independent review; no new verified correction made here.

pages.title: Autonomic Dysreflexia
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: PVA recognition, pediatric threshold, acute monitoring and treatment sequence, nifedipine route.
pages.notes: Replaced 2002 protocol citation with current PVA-hosted guideline; corrected pediatric threshold, acute monitoring, pre-instrumentation BP treatment, sublingual nifedipine and tachycardia exclusion. Historical prevalence, all prophylactic regimens and every IV dose were not fully checked; comprehensive drug-table verification remains desirable.

pages.title: Neurogenic Lower Urinary Tract Dysfunction
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Full section landing/navigation text only.
pages.notes: Full text read. This is not independent verification of the linked disease-specific treatment summaries; those pages have separate entries.

pages.title: Neurogenic Lower Urinary Tract Dysfunction
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Risk tiers, surveillance and pressure interpretation; alpha-blocker scope, outlet goals and augmentation indications.
pages.notes: Corrected alpha-blocker applicability, misleading combined bladder-neck incision/reconstruction row, prerequisite hydronephrosis, narrow leakage differential and universal recurrent-UTI threshold. Classification counts, epidemiology and every named drug/device statement not independently verified.

pages.title: Cauda Equina Syndrome
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Emergency referral and non-universal chronic phenotype, risk-directed surveillance and reconstruction.
pages.notes: Original full text had no references and asserted fixed lifelong retention, incompetent outlet, AUS dominance and routine screening UA. Replaced with sourced concise clinical framework. CES-specific long-term comparative surgery evidence remains limited; no default reconstruction or fixed recovery deadline asserted.

pages.title: Multiple Sclerosis
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Unknown-risk testing, CIC threshold, alpha-blocker and augmentation scope, UTI pseudo-relapse.
pages.notes: Corrected low-symptom equals low-risk assumption, mandatory PVR 100 catheterization, SNM/renal-injury prerequisites for augmentation and infection equals true relapse. Botulinum dosing and population-specific efficacy need separate label/primary-trial verification; no global clinical approval.

pages.title: Parkinson's Disease
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: AUA medication sequencing and ICS PD/MSA phenotyping.
pages.notes: Qualified mandatory beta-3-first/trospium-safe framing and categorical no-DSD statement. Reviewed large 709-patient VUDS series supporting heterogeneous PD/MSA risk, without adding unnecessary cohort statistics. Procedural efficacy, prevalence and every MSA restriction not independently resolved.

pages.title: Spina Bifida
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: SBA age-specific surveillance, symptom-driven augmentation cystoscopy, individualized childbirth.
pages.notes: Corrected baseline studies by three months and age-based follow-up; removed annual cystoscopy after ten years. Qualified leak protection, inevitable preventability and blanket cesarean preference. Surgical-frequency assertions and epidemiology remain unverified.

pages.title: Spinal Cord Injury
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Safe assisted emptying, alpha-blocker scope, SNM restriction and existing risk surveillance.
pages.notes: Aligned assisted emptying and drug scope; corrected AUA SNM restriction from complete SCI only to SCI/spina bifida. Prior risk-based follow-up remains consistent. US epidemiology/life-expectancy claims are dated and not independently updated; these require NSCISC verification.

pages.title: Stroke and Dementia
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: AUA storage medication choice, conditional low-risk status and obstruction assessment.
pages.notes: Qualified mandatory class order and cognitively risk-free trospium implication; removed categorical TURP-will-not-help inference from weak stream. Caregiver strategies retained. National incidence, prognosis, catheter bacteriuria rates and comparative procedural efficacy not revalidated.

pages.title: Retroperitoneal Fibrosis (RPF)
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Major randomized treatment changes: 2025 MTX/lower-dose prednisone noninferiority trial and IgG4-RD MITIGATE/FDA indication; 2011 maintenance design.
pages.notes: Added two missing major trial updates with population and uncertainty limits. Corrected only-RCT and maintenance-versus-induction interpretation. Broad PET-superiority statements, preferred biopsy route, all cohort percentages and the duplicated older review remain unresolved for deeper source verification.

pages.title: UPJ Obstruction
pages.readScope: full MDX text including bibliography
scope: Full text screened; current EAU pediatric guidance located. Corrections deferred at user-requested travel checkpoint.
pages.notes: Priority continuation: prolonged renogram half-time is presented as diagnostic by itself; absolute crossing-vessel/transposition mandates, universal function improvement and fixed infant robot size/age thresholds need source checking. No edit made to this page. Do not treat this full-text screen as validated clinical guidance.

methodology: Full MDX and bibliography screening, with targeted primary-guideline and major-trial verification of named claims. Checked does not mean every numerical claim, reference, figure or drug/device label is validated. Unresolved entries explicitly identify unread work.

openEvidenceSurvey.method: Survey treated as leads, not authority; present means found in source and does not itself mean independently validated. Paused at travel checkpoint.

decisions.notes: MUSA not found by acronym in clinical pages during targeted search; search DOI and existing evidence tables before adding. No new MUSA verification in this checkpoint.
FUTURE Lancet trial already summarized in OAB; HTA companion not separately verified.
NEUROGED identity and correction verified; correction is funding statement only. Full recommendation integration remains pending.
Do not adopt survey claims of universal beta-3-first therapy or SNM/Botox equivalence. Current page preserves AUA SCI/spina-bifida SNM restriction; exact recent study review remains pending.
IUGA/ICS fistula success consensus needs original-source review and exact definition, not automatic worldwide incurable label.
FIGO 2025 DOI present in obstetric fistula bibliography; that page is not yet full-text reviewed in this audit.
Global IC/BPS consensus DOI present in IC and chronic-pelvic-pain pages; full source/page review pending.
IC/PPS and pelvic-pain leads await primary-source review. Reject no claim merely from survey; especially do not treat Botox as the sole strong-evidence IC therapy.

Rome V questionnaire, PF consortium, TNT and SUBSoNIC await review; do not equate distinct stimulation modalities or call a failed superiority trial proof of no benefit.
